app.title: Dental Adventure
app.subtitle: Your first dental mission!
parent.whichVisit: Which visit is your child having?
milo.welcome: Welcome, {name}! I'm Milo the Tooth. Let's explore the dental clinic together!
clinic.title: Meet the Dental Clinic
clinic.intro: This is the dental clinic, {name}! Tap everything to see what it does.
clinic.chair.name: The Big Comfy Chair
clinic.chair.desc: This chair moves up and down like a slow ride. You sit here while the dentist helps your teeth.
clinic.light.name: The Sunshine Light
clinic.light.desc: This bright light helps the dentist see your teeth. It shines on your mouth, not your eyes.
clinic.sink.name: The Little Sink
clinic.sink.desc: This tiny sink is for rinsing. You can swish water and spit right here!
clinic.table.name: The Tool Table
clinic.table.desc: The dentist's helpers sit on this little table, all clean and ready.
clinic.done: You explored the whole clinic, {name}! Amazing!
tools.title: Meet the Friendly Tools
tools.intro: These are the dentist's little helpers, {name}. Tap each one to say hello!
tools.groupDone: You met this whole team! Look how shiny the tooth is getting!
tools.done: You met all the tools, {name}! They can't wait to help your teeth!
tool.mirror.name: Dental Mirror
tool.mirror.desc: A tiny round mirror that helps the dentist peek at every tooth.
tool.mirror.fact: It feels smooth and cool, like a little spoon.
tool.explorer.name: Tooth Counter
tool.explorer.desc: This thin helper gently touches each tooth to count and check it.
tool.explorer.fact: You might feel a tiny tickle when it taps.
tool.suction.name: Thirsty Straw
tool.suction.desc: This silly straw drinks up the water in your mouth.
tool.suction.fact: It makes a funny slurp sound, like the end of a milkshake!
tool.syringe.name: Wind and Water Wand
tool.syringe.desc: This wand blows a little air and sprays a little water to clean your teeth.
tool.syringe.fact: The air feels cold, like a tiny wind on your tooth.
tool.brush.name: Polishing Brush
tool.brush.desc: This spinning brush cleans your teeth and makes them shiny.
tool.brush.fact: It buzzes and tickles a little, and your teeth feel super smooth after.
tool.xray.name: Tooth Camera
tool.xray.desc: This camera takes a super picture so the dentist can see inside your teeth.
tool.xray.fact: You just stay still like a statue for one moment. That's all!
tool.ring.name: Tooth Hugger Ring
tool.ring.desc: This little ring gives one tooth a gentle hug so it stays still and dry.
tool.ring.fact: You'll feel a little push, like a snug sock for your tooth.
tool.umbrella.name: Tooth Umbrella
tool.umbrella.desc: This soft sheet keeps your tooth dry, like a tiny raincoat.
tool.umbrella.fact: Your tooth stays cozy and dry under its umbrella.
tool.spray.name: Sleepy Spray
tool.spray.desc: This special gel helps your tooth feel calm and cozy before the dentist works.
tool.spray.fact: It tastes a little like fruit, and your tooth feels sleepy and relaxed.
practice.brush.title: Make the Tooth Sparkle
practice.brush.intro: Oh no, {name} — this tooth has sticky spots! Grab the brush and clean them all!
practice.brush.done: Wow! You made it sparkle, {name}! What a clean tooth!
prepare.title: Prepare the Tooth
prepare.intro: Let's get this tooth ready, {name}! Follow me step by step.
prepare.step.ring: First, the Tooth Hugger Ring. Tap it to give the tooth a gentle hug!
prepare.step.umbrella: Now the Tooth Umbrella! Tap it to keep the tooth dry.
prepare.step.spray: Last one — the Sleepy Spray! Tap it so the tooth feels calm and cozy.
prepare.done: You got the tooth ready like a real dental hero, {name}!
spray.title: Sleepy Spray Mission
spray.intro: The tooth wants a quiet little rest, {name}. Close your eyes and count with me, slowly, to ten.
spray.done: Great counting with me, {name}! The tooth feels calm and cozy now.
visit.title: Your Dental Visit
visit.meetDr: This is Dr. Nour! Dentists wear a mask to keep everything clean. Tap the mask!
visit.maskOff: See? It's still Dr. Nour underneath, smiling at you!
visit.stopSignal: Here's a superpower, {name}: if you ever want a break, just raise your hand — and the dentist pauses. Try it!
visit.stopSignalDone: Perfect! You're the boss of your visit.
visit.step.chair: First you sit in the big comfy chair. It leans back slowly, like a lazy chair ride.
visit.step.light: Then the sunshine light turns on so Dr. Nour can see your teeth.
visit.step.mirror: Dr. Nour looks at your teeth with the little mirror and counts them.
visit.step.clean: Then the brush tickles your teeth clean until they're shiny!
visit.done: And that's the whole visit, {name}! You knew every single step!
reward.hero: You are now a DENTAL HERO!
reward.narration: You did it, {name}! Five stars! You know the clinic, the tools, and the dentist. You are a true Dental Hero!
cert.title: Dental Hero Certificate
cert.for: for bravely exploring the dental clinic
